styles.label: Culture
styles.blurb: NASCAR Hall of Fame, museums and historic Uptown.

styles.label: Food
styles.blurb: BBQ, Southern plates and a fast-growing brewery scene.

styles.label: Family
styles.blurb: Discovery Place, Carowinds and the U.S. National Whitewater Center.

stays.why: Walk to museums, sports venues and restaurants. Best base for a first visit without a car.
On the LYNX Blue Line, packed with breweries and rail-trail walks; quick ride to Uptown.
Quiet, leafy streets near Uptown; good for walking and biking, a short drive to most sights.
Arts district with live music, galleries and bars; on the Blue Line north of Uptown.

food: Try Carolina-style pulled pork BBQ with vinegar-based sauce; local BBQ joints range roughly $12–20 a plate.
Southern classics like shrimp and grits or fried chicken are easy to find; lunch plates often $10–18.
The brewery scene is strong in South End and NoDa; many taprooms allow outside food or have food trucks.
Uptown and South End food halls are good for groups and picky eaters; expect $10–15 per dish.
Check hours before you go: many kitchens close early on Sundays and Mondays.
more_time: Swap a city afternoon for the U.S. National Whitewater Center: rafting, ropes courses and trails; check prices and hours on the day.
Families can add a day at Carowinds amusement park on the city's south edge; check the seasonal calendar first.
History buffs can drive out to Historic Rosedale or the Charlotte Museum of History; confirm opening days before going.

recommend.why: Two nights covers Uptown museums, a South End or NoDa evening and one outdoor day; add a night for Carowinds or the whitewater center.

month_notes: January: cold, highs near 10°C and lows near 1°C. Pack a warm coat; some outdoor attractions run shorter hours.
February: still chilly, highs around 14°C. Good for indoor museums and food; expect about 10 rain days.
March: mild and warming, highs near 17°C. A good shoulder month for walking and parks.
April: pleasant, highs around 22°C and fewer rain days. One of the best months to visit.
May: warm, highs near 27°C. Great for outdoor days; keep an eye on afternoon storms.
June: hot, highs near 31°C. Plan outdoor time in the morning; about 12 rain days.
July: hottest month, highs near 33°C and lows near 22°C. Stay hydrated and use shade at midday.
August: hot and the wettest month, about 15 rain days. Carry a rain jacket and have indoor backups.
September: still warm, highs near 28°C and fewer rain days. A comfortable month for sightseeing.
October: mild and dry, highs near 22°C with about 7 rain days. Excellent for parks and walking.
November: cooler, highs near 16°C. Layer up; evenings get chilly.
December: cold, highs near 13°C and lows near 3°C. Festive lights Uptown; pack a warm jacket.

climate_guide.summary: Humid subtropical: hot, stormy summers and mild-to-cold winters. Spring and autumn are the most comfortable.

items.title: Best time: April, May, September, October
items.text: Highs around 22–28°C with fewer rain days. Ideal for walking, parks and outdoor dining.

items.title: Hot, humid summer (June to August)
items.text: Highs near 31–33°C and muggy. Do outdoor sights early; expect afternoon thunderstorms.

items.title: Wettest in summer
items.text: August has about 15 rain days, July about 13. Showers are often short; carry a light rain jacket.

items.title: Cold winters (December to February)
items.text: Highs near 10–14°C and lows near 1–3°C. Snow is rare but possible; pack warm layers.

items.title: Shoulder months are mild
items.text: March and November sit around 16–17°C highs. Comfortable with a jacket, good for city walks.

items.title: What to pack
items.text: Breathable clothes and sunscreen for summer; a warm coat and layers for winter; an umbrella or rain jacket year-round.

transit.best: LYNX Blue Line light rail plus walking in Uptown; use ride apps for outer districts.

modes.text: LYNX Blue Line light rail runs north-south, $2.20 one-way, $6.60 day pass. The CityLYNX Gold Line streetcar is free and links Uptown with Elizabeth.
CATS buses fan out from Uptown Transportation Center, $2.20 one-way.
Taxis are metered; Uber and Lyft operate widely.
Useful for outer districts and day trips; Uptown is walkable but the city is car-oriented outside it.
Uptown is walkable, but outer districts are car-oriented; use a GPS. Bikes and e-scooters (Bird, Lime) work best in Dilworth and Myers Park.
